create_VLMAgent: create a VLMAgent instance with config and args to initialize a MiniGPT-4 based VLM agent for home robot tasks
run_act_method: run the VLMAgent act method with observations to execute the state machine and return navigation actions
ask_vlm_for_plan: ask the VLM for a high-level plan given a world representation of object crops and task description
get_obj_centric_world_representation: get an object-centric world representation by sampling cropped images from the instance memory for VLM planning
switch_skill_state: switch the VLMAgent to the next skill in the remaining actions queue using from_pred_to_skill parsing
